tailoring.headline: Product Owner E-Commerce & SAP Commerce Cloud Specialist | Java & OCC APIs
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional E-Commerce professional with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211), Java, Spring and OCC REST APIs. Proven expertise in business requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping, PIM/ERP/MDM data integration and agile stakeholder management. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer bridging business needs and technical execution to drive high-performance digital commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner E-commerce
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Product Owner E-commerce role at The Schippers Group. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and shaping enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a unique techno-functional perspective that bridges strategic business requirements with robust technical execution in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Requirements & User Stories
bullets.text: Worked extensively in techno-functional roles analysing business requirements, authoring user stories and functional specifications, and translating stakeholder needs into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Integrations
bullets.text: Designed and optimized complex data flows and PIM-to-Hybris pipelines across PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms, ensuring seamless product catalog synchronization and system stability.

bullets.label: API & Headless Delivery
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for multi-channel storefronts, driving modern digital experiences in agile international environments.

bullets.label: Agile Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with product owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams to map processes, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and steer feature delivery.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional e-commerce background aligns with your product goals.

tailoring.why_company: The Schippers Group's dedication to innovation and efficiency in agricultural e-commerce presents an exciting challenge. I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional expertise to help scale your digital platforms, align business strategy with technical execution, and deliver exceptional value to your international customers.
tailoring.motivation_short: Combining 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise with strong techno-functional analysis to drive E-commerce product delivery at The Schippers Group.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I am very interested in the Product Owner E-commerce role at The Schippers Group. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms and bridging business requirements with technical delivery, I'd love to connect. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Product Owner E-commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Product Owner E-commerce position at The Schippers Group. With over 5 years of professional experience in enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud) and a strong techno-functional background in requirements analysis, user stories, and system integration, I am well-positioned to contribute effectively to your digital roadmap.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am available starting 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
